power_domains_summary.VDD1: First core supply (~1.8 V) — charge-pump / wordline / high-voltage core domain.
power_domains_summary.VDD2H: Second core / periphery supply, HIGH operating point — DVFSC at higher frequencies.
power_domains_summary.VDD2L: Second core / periphery supply, LOW operating point — DVFSC at lower frequencies.
power_domains_summary.VDDQ: DQ / IO supply, reduced to 0.5 V for low IO power.
power_domains_summary.Vref_ca: Internally generated reference for CA / CS (per FSP).
power_domains_summary.Vref_dq: Internally generated reference for DQ / DMI (per FSP / DVFSQ).

power_up_sequence: 2. Ramp supplies in the defined order: VDD1 (~1.8 V) -> VDD2H / VDD2L -> VDDQ (0.5 V).
3. Once stable, deassert RESET_n; wait the defined reset-exit time.
5. Program mode registers (FSP, RL/WL, bank mode, WCK ratio, link ECC / DBI, ODT / drive strength / Vref).
6. Run ZQ calibration; perform initial WCK2CK sync; train read/write timing for the active FSP.

low_power_modes_summary.Power_Down: Entered via a CA command (PD); no CKE; lasts until CS next goes high.
low_power_modes_summary.Self_Refresh: Entered via SRE; CK may be stopped per the defined window.
low_power_modes_summary.Deep_Sleep_Mode: Lowest standby power; SRE with DSE; full re-init on exit.
low_power_modes_summary.DVFS_DVFSC: Dynamic voltage/frequency scaling; DVFSC selects VDD2H/VDD2L; DVFSQ scales the DQ domain.
low_power_modes_summary.Write_X_Data_Copy: Write-X (all-zero/all-one) and Data-Copy reduce data-transfer activity.

iDD_states_summary.description: Idle / standby current with banks precharged.
Deep Sleep Mode current — lowest standby power.

dvfs_summary.DVFSC: Dynamic Voltage Frequency Scaling Core — selects VDD2H or VDD2L to scale core voltage with frequency.
dvfs_summary.DVFSQ: Scales the DQ-domain voltage / Vref(dq) with the FSP.
dvfs_summary.FSP: Frequency Set Points (FSP-OP / FSP-WR) hold per-frequency RL/WL/ODT/Vref/DFE, switched on a DVFS change.

fields.notes: The defining LPDDR5 power features versus DDR3 are: (1) on-demand full-speed WCK / RDQS clocking (enabled only when needed); (2) VDDQ reduced to 0.5 V; (3) elimination of the CKE pin (low-power entry via CA command bounded by CS); (4) DVFS / DVFSC core-voltage scaling; (5) Deep Sleep Mode; (6) Write-X / Data-Copy data-transfer reduction.
